## Where

Based in Barcelona and Mallorca. Local in Spain and Portugal. English and Spanish.

## Role

On-set digital technician (digitech) and lighting assistant for fashion and advertising stills.

- Capture One sessions, naming, live view
- Colour on set
- Dual backup before cards go back in the bag
- Client screens, power, data
- Lighting assist
- Phase One Certified Professional
- Cameras: Phase One, Hasselblad, Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fuji

Not a DIT. Not video. Stills only.
